summary: Iteration 3 backend testing: added 10 new tests for the 3 new features (ZIP bulk import via async background task, PDF segment export via reportlab, and /api/reminders bucketed 30/60/90+). All 46 tests pass (36 regression + 10 new). No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1040 lines — consider splitting into modules (vision, segments, reminders, customers, csv) for maintainability.
vision_jobs collection has no TTL/cleanup — long-running deployments will accumulate job docs; consider TTL index on created_at.
asyncio.create_task in /vision/extract-zip: if the uvicorn worker restarts mid-job, job stays queued forever. Consider a startup sweep that marks orphaned running/queued jobs as failed.
In _process_zip_job, results list is written in full on every image via $set — for larger ZIPs this is O(N^2) bandwidth. Consider $push per item.
/api/reminders response returns ALL matching customers without pagination — could be heavy for large tenants; add limit/cursor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 46 tests covering iterations 1-3. New classes: TestVisionZip (3), TestSegmentPDF (3), TestReminders (4). Zip flow test takes ~10-15s (real Emergent Vision LLM). PDF verified via %PDF magic + >2KB size. Reminders verified bucket boundaries via days_since_last_order integer.
